title: Wet Scrubber
model_title: Wet Scrubber — Venturi Throat with Cyclonic Separator (Particulate & Mist Removal)

introduction.definition: A venturi wet scrubber removes fine dust and mist from gas. The gas accelerates through a narrow throat where injected liquid is shattered into fine droplets; particles impact the droplets, and a cyclonic separator then spins the dirty droplets out. It can also cool the gas and absorb soluble gases.
applications: Dust from kilns, dryers, furnaces and incinerators
Sticky / wet or explosive dusts unsuitable for bag filters

pressure.title: Energy in the throat buys efficiency
pressure.description: Gas accelerates to high velocity in the venturi throat and shatters the injected liquid into fine droplets; dust particles impact them because of the large relative velocity. Collection efficiency rises with throat pressure drop (often ≈ 25–100 mbar for fine particulate) — the fan power pays for it. The diffuser recovers part of the pressure, and the cyclonic separator then removes the dirty droplets. Wet scrubbers also cool and saturate the gas and can absorb soluble gases.

video_tutorials.title: Wet Scrubber — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Wet Scrubber.
A venturi wet scrubber removes fine dust and mist from gas.
The gas accelerates through a narrow throat where injected liquid is shattered into fine droplets; particles impact the droplets, and a cyclonic separator then spins the dirty droplets out.
It can also cool the gas and absorb soluble gases.
Typical applications include dust from kilns, dryers, furnaces and incinerators; sticky / wet or explosive dusts unsuitable for bag filters.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Recycle Pump (bleed of slurry to treatment), Recycle Pump (bleed of slurry to treatment) — Shaft & Coupling (turning).
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

script.narration: How the Wet Scrubber works.
Dusty gas enters the converging section.
Liquid is injected at the throat.
Droplets capture particles.
The separator removes droplets.
Slurry is recycled / bled.
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.
Gas accelerates to high velocity in the venturi throat and shatters the injected liquid into fine droplets; dust particles impact them because of the large relative velocity.

video_tutorials.title: Wet Scrubber — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Wet Scrubber.
Check ΔP, liquid flow and pH.
Inspect throat / nozzles for erosion.
Reline throat; pump overhaul.
Watch for low efficiency: visible emission. Common cause: low ΔP / liquid flow.
Watch for mist carry-over: wet stack. Common cause: separator overloaded.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
